text:
lucy: FYI starting preflight for midnight cutover (00:00 UTC). Targets: api v2.8.5, runtime 3.4.2-quant, router 4.0.11, console 1.9.4. Change window 00:00-02:00. Canary plan: 4% x10m -> 20% x20m -> full. Rollback plan: unpin runtime+api, shift router traffic to stable. @omar (runtime) @devon (router) pls ack blockers.

omar: ack. Runtime 3.4.2 includes a small KV cache rewrite (kv_window=16->20). For safety i want a runtime variant runtime:3.4.2-kv16 to keep kv_window=16 in canary. I'll publish in ~5m.

devon: ack. Router 4.0.11 introduces a multi-header rename (X-RW-Tenant -> X-Tenant-Id). Console team hasn't flipped accept-header flag yet. Recommend router env OVERRIDE_HEADER_RENAME=false for canary. Memory looks fine on staging.

lucy: plan updated: runtime variant runtime:3.4.2-kv16 for canary; router canary OVERRIDE_HEADER_RENAME=false. SRE: watch p50/p95/p99, 5xx, token latency. Abort thresholds: p99>800ms or 5xx>0.25%.

deploybot: queued wave rw-17500. Canary config: {canary_pct:4, canary_stage_min:10, aborts:[p99>800ms,5xx>0.25%]}.

deploybot: canary started at 00:02 UTC. Deploying api v2.8.5 -> ok. Deploying runtime:3.4.2-kv16 -> ok. Deploying router 4.0.11 (HEADER_RENAME=false) -> rolling to 4%.

sre-bot: shortchecks at 00:12 UTC: health endpoints 200/200, p99 baseline 710ms. No infra alerts.

omar: runtime logs show occasional kv_miss spikes on one pod:
[00:13:04] WARN kv_fetch miss latency=920ms pod=runtime-7
It's isolated but above abort p99. Suggest hold and investigate before ramp.

lucy: hold ramp. @devon keep router at 4% and pause increases. @omar can you roll runtime back to 3.4.1 across the canary subset if the spike persists?

omar: initiating runtime rollback to 3.4.1 now. Command:
```
deploybot rollback component=runtime target=3.4.1 wave=rw-17500 initiated_by=omar
```
deploybot: acknowledged. Rolling runtime back to 3.4.1 on canary subset. Pausing further ramps.

sre-bot: re-eval after rollback at 00:20 UTC: p99 dropped to 660ms, errors stable 0.05%. Canary paused at 4% (auto-paused due to rollback).

devon: router can keep HEADER_RENAME=false until console flips flag. I'll prepare rollout notes for enabling rename once console confirms.

lucy: summary/action items: 1) mark kv_window change for extended perf in staging, 2) add a quick canary check that flags single-pod p99 spikes (not just global p99), 3) ensure deploybot variant mapping step verifies image variant tags. Reschedule full window until fixes. Thanks all for fast rollback.

ops-bot: filing follow-up ticket RW-17500-POSTMORTEM and pinging owners.

omar: creating PR to add more staging tests for kv_window.

devon: will coordinate console team for header rename flip.

lucy: closing this preflight thread, will update release doc and pick new slot after follow-ups.
